evidence.excerpt: The project addresses the degradation of in-circuit and boundary-scan test coverage that occurs as solder joints, contact pads, and board laminates age under repeated thermal excursions. The core deliverables are a set of empirically validated coverage-lifetime models parameterised by thermal profile severity, board material, and component package type, and a software tool that uses these models to predict coverage at any point in a product's operating lifetime. The tool was demonstrated on board designs provided by two industrial partners. The project also produced a revised DFT guideline document tailored to boards used in outdoor electronics enclosures in continental European climate conditions.
